d.s: Sikament ECO-3 W is a water reducer and non-chloride accelerator admixture based on modified copolymer technology, which provides a cost effective solution in accelerated soft concrete.
a: Higher slump can be achieved without further addition of water.
Improved setting times of concrete in winter conditions.
Enables concrete to achieve internal cohesiveness with improved placement properties.
us: Sikament ECO-3 W is used to accelerate the finishing and setting time of concrete when ambient temperatures are low. (Set times are better than the times associated with the action of normal water reducing admixtures). Early age development of concrete and mortar mixes is improved.
d.pk: Bulk deliveries, 1000 litre IBC, 205 litre drum, 10 litre container.

sec.t: Sikament ECO-3 W complies and exceeds the limits of AS 1478.1-2000 as type WRAc.
Mixture modified co-polymer and complexing agents
Stored at temperature between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C protected from direct sunlight.

Sikament ECO-3 W should be added to the gauging water or poured simultaneously into the concrete mixer. For optimum utilisation of the high water reduction, we recommend thorough mixing at a minimal wet mixing time of 1 minute/cubic metre. The addition of the remaining gauging water to fine tune concrete consistency may be started after 2/3 of the wet mixing time, to avoid surplus water in concrete.
Sikament ECO-3 W can be used in conjunction with many Sika Concrete admixtures, except Sikament NN. When using Sikament ECO-3 W, site trials are always recommended to achieve the best results.

Typical dosage is 600ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. Sikament ECO-3 W can be dosed between 350 ml to 1200 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material to improve water reduction and setting time. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials with the particular concrete mix design.
